title: テイルズ オブ ファンタジア

versions.note: the cartridge TALES OF PHANTASIA (6 MB, extended HiROM)

sources: The harness alone, from the game's cartridge on bsnes (docs/first-script.md): no reader's snapshots, no memory written, no play outside the harness. The cartridge and snaps were studied outside it

Found in play: the script lies packed and no page stands in memory as codes (page_buffer found no buffer of one); each character is drawn into tiles of video memory and laid out by a tile map in work RAM, the font fixed on a grid of 14 by 16 pixels
A byte (0x7E20A0) is 5 while text is shown, a window or narration, and 0 while none is: the map and the tiles keep the last page after it closes
The dictionary: 159 pictures, each page's cells beside its picture, read in play, since the font in the cartridge is packed too
Played from power-on through the prologue, the morning at the hero's home and the village, and into two houses, with the script loaded
What the script said agreed with the rows read off 31 of 31 pictures, over 4 scenes (4, 13, 9 and 5). No screen without text was among them
notes: Read by the script games/sfc/SHVC-ATVJ.lua: the message window's rows (and narration drawn the same way), each character by its picture, said once the page stands. Not read: menus, fights' messages. A character not met in play comes out as U+FFFD.
